7344.title: Cancellation cleanup lacks adoption provenance
7344.rootCauseOneLine: Adoption preserves provisioning status but not durable adoption provenance, so cancellation treats the pre-existing workspace as a fresh allocation and dispatches removal.
7344.proposedFix: Design persistent adoption provenance and release only adopted claims on cancellation; retain fresh-allocation cleanup and cover restart recovery.
7344.caveats: Service-level reproduction with real migrated SQLite and a spy removal provider; initial orphan provisioning state is seeded. Production frequency and actual filesystem data loss are unmeasured. Test and patch are embedded inline.
